jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Resend is growing fast, and there are now over 4 million developers using it. As a Product Engineer, you will help shape the core product experience of Resend.

This role is for someone who cares about both how the product works and how the product feels. You should be comfortable moving between frontend, backend, product thinking, design details, and user experience.

This role is fully remote based in Americas or European timezones, with some expected travel for team offsites, conferences, meetups, and more.

Read more about how we work, how we hire, and what we value here.

In this role, you will…

  • Build polished product experiences for users using Resend.

  • Turn complex technical concepts into simple, clear, and trustworthy user experiences.

  • Own features end-to-end: product thinking, UX details, implementation, instrumentation, launch, and iteration.

  • Collaborate closely with design, engineering, and customer success to understand user problems and ship high-quality solutions.

  • Build debugging and observability experiences that help users understand what happened to their emails, webhooks, domains, and API requests.

  • Work primarily with TypeScript, React, Next.js, and modern web technologies.

  • Talk to users, understand customer pain, and turn those insights into better product decisions.

  • Help raise the bar for craft, performance, accessibility, reliability, and product quality across Resend.

You will be a great fit if you...

  • Have 6+ years of experience building and shipping high-quality web products.

  • Are fluent in writing and speaking English.

  • Have strong experience with TypeScript, React, and modern frontend development.

  • Are comfortable working across the stack, including APIs, databases, server-side logic, and product infrastructure.

  • Care deeply about UX, interaction details, and product polish.

  • Can take an ambiguous customer problem and turn it into a clear, shippable solution.

  • Have strong product judgment

  • Love helping developers and care about developer experience

  • Are comfortable working in open-ended problems and situations

  • Have a “default to action” mindset

  • Are hands-on and enjoy solving problems directly

  • Have low ego and enjoy collaborating with design, engineering, and customer success

You will be an exceptional fit if you also...

  • Have built products for developers, infrastructure teams, or technical users

  • Have experience with email, deliverability, DNS, webhooks, logs, observability, or API platforms

  • Have strong visual taste and can build interfaces that feel fast, simple, and polished

  • Have experience working in small, high-ownership teams

What it means to join the team:

  • Autonomy to "just ship it"

  • 100% remote team with flexible working schedules

  • Modern tech stack (Next.js, Raycast, Notion, etc.)

  • Honest and low-ego team

  • Ownership of problems and solutions

  • Comp: $150,000 - $170,000 USD, commensurate with experience

About Resend

We are building the modern email sending platform for developers. We care deeply about quality, craft, and the developer experience.

Our fully remote team of 50 spans 15 countries and counting. We're backed by a16z, Y Combinator, and others. Meet the humans →

jobs.title: Security Engineer, Platform
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Resend is growing fast, and there are now over 4 million developers using it. As the Platform Squad, we are responsible for the internal platform and reliability foundations that let Resend teams build, deploy, observe, and operate services safely.

This role is fully remote based in Americas or European timezones, with some expected travel for team offsites, conferences, meetups, and more.

Read more about how we work, how we hire, and what we value here.

In this role, you will…

  • Build and improve the security foundations of Resend’s platform, including API keys, service permissions, secrets management, tenant isolation, audit logs, and internal access controls

  • Help design secure defaults for new services, workers, queues, databases, internal tools, and deployment pipelines

  • Improve detection and response for suspicious access, leaked credentials, abnormal sending behavior, privilege changes, and sensitive system events

  • Review and update our processes/pipelines so that security is “built-in”, not “bolt-on”

  • Raise the security bar

You will be a great fit if you...

  • Have experience securing production infrastructure, cloud environments, APIs, developer platforms, or multi-tenant SaaS products

  • Can write code and are comfortable reading application, infrastructure, and deployment code

  • Understand authentication, authorization, secrets, IAM, logging, audit trails, incident response, and secure deployment pipelines.

  • Independently prioritize and drive your day-to-day as the first dedicated security hire

  • Prefer practical improvements over heavy processes

  • Are low-ego, direct, curious, and willing to learn from others

  • Care about developer experience and believe security should be easy to adopt

You will be an exceptional fit if you also...

  • Have experience with email infrastructure, transactional email, sender reputation, domain verification, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, webhooks, or abuse prevention

  • Have secured cloud infrastructure using tools like AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes, Cloudflare, or similar systems

  • Have experience with open source security, GitHub organization hardening, package publishing, dependency review, or supply-chain security

  • Have helped a company prepare for SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, enterprise security reviews, or customer trust processes without turning engineering into a compliance machine

  • Have built security observability, alerting, detection pipelines, or incident response workflows

  • Have worked closely with Trust & Safety, anti-abuse, fraud, or platform integrity teams

  • Have experience designing security systems for high-scale developer products

What it means to join the team:

  • Autonomy to "just ship it"

  • 100% remote team with flexible working schedules

  • Modern tech stack (Next.js, Raycast, Notion, etc.)

  • Honest and low-ego team

  • Ownership of problems and solutions

  • Comp: $140,000 - $160,000 USD, commensurate with experience

About Resend

We are building the modern email sending platform for developers. We care deeply about quality, craft, and the developer experience.

Our fully remote team of 50 spans 15 countries and counting. We're backed by a16z, Y Combinator, and others. Meet the humans →

jobs.title: Backend Engineer (MTA), Trust & Safety
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Resend is building the most accessible email platform for developers. As we’ve grown to 4M+ users and continue to onboard thousands of new users every day, the pressure of maintaining a safe place for good senders continues to build.

This role is fully remote-based in Americas or European time zones, with some expected travel for team off-sites, conferences, meetups, and more.

Read more about how we work, how we hire, and what we value here.

In this role, you will…

  • Build and operate Resend’s email transport infrastructure

  • Work on SMTP delivery, MTA systems, routing, retries, backoff strategies, and delivery controls

  • Design systems for domain-level, provider-level, customer-level, and IP-level throttling

  • Build infrastructure for shared IP pools, dedicated IPs, warmup execution, and reputation-aware routing

  • Improve how Resend classifies bounces, deferrals, transient failures, hard failures, and delivery outcomes

  • Build tools that help the team debug delivery issues by customer, domain, mailbox provider, route, IP, message type, and event

  • Help design systems that make sending behavior safer, more observable, and easier to operate

  • Translate reputation strategy into backend systems

  • Partner with Trust & Safety and Core Sending to build controls that protect Resend’s sending network from abuse

  • Participate in incident response for sending, provider, and deliverability-sensitive issues

  • Be on-call for critical services

You will be a great fit if you...

  • Have strong backend engineering experience

  • Have worked on email, messaging, notifications, communications, infrastructure, or other high-volume delivery systems

  • Understand queues, workers, retries, idempotency, rate limits, backpressure, and distributed systems

  • Have experience or strong interest in SMTP, MTAs, DNS, bounces, deferrals, DNS, IP pools, and mailbox-provider behavior

  • Care about reliability, observability, operational excellence, and reducing blast radius

  • Have low ego, high ownership, and strong taste for simple systems

You will be an exceptional fit if you also...

  • Have experience working on applications with a high workload

  • Know about email best practices, or are willing to learn more about this space

  • Are experienced in Typescript and Golang

What it means to join the team:

  • Autonomy to "just ship it"

  • 100% remote team with flexible working schedules

  • Modern tech stack (Typescript, AWS, Go, Postgres, Datadog)

  • Honest and low-ego team

  • Ownership of problems and solutions

  • Comp: $150,000 - $170,000 USD, commensurate with experience

About Resend

We are building the modern email sending platform for developers. We care deeply about quality, craft, and the developer experience.

Our fully remote team of 50 spans 15 countries and counting. We're backed by a16z, Y Combinator, and others. Meet the humans →

jobs.title: Growth Marketer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Resend is growing fast, and there are now over 4 million developers using it.

We're a small marketing team focused on content, social, events, and community. Now, we're looking for our first Growth Marketer to bring visibility to our funnel: measuring what's working, fixing what isn't, and creating experiments.

This role is fully remote based in UTC-3 to UTC-8 time zones, with some expected travel for team offsites, conferences, meetups, and more.

Read more about how we work, how we hire, and what we value here.

In this role, you will…

  • Own the acquisition funnel end-to-end: understand where sign-ups come from, which channels are accelerating or stalling, and why

  • Amplify externally what we build internally: turn launches into extended reach without just throwing money at the problem

  • Optimize free-to-paid conversion: find the features that drive upgrades, and build the campaigns (drip, in-product, lifecycle) that surface them at the right moment

  • Improve our landing pages with real data: get into the weeds of traditional SEO and AI recommendations (AEO/GEO)

  • Evaluate paid spend: see how sponsorships, ads, and events affect our distribution. Double down on what works, and consider dropping what doesn't

You will be a great fit if you...

  • Understand how developers think and how to market to them

  • Have owned free-to-paid conversion or lifecycle/activation before

  • Are genuinely analytical and comfortable with data, fluent in funnels and cohorts

  • Write clearly and ship fast: a v0 experiment this week beats a perfect plan next month

  • Think critically about a data point, and go deep into how that's measured

You will be an exceptional fit if you also...

  • Can set up attribution and experimentation infrastructure yourself, not just brief someone else to

  • Can run lean and make a small budget go far

  • Understand that not every investment needs to have a short term effect

  • Have a technical background to make website changes on our own

What it means to join the team:

  • Autonomy to "just ship it"

  • AI-native mentality with unlimited token policy

jobs.title: Technical Account Executive
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Over 4M developers have used Resend, and we're onboarding hundreds of new paying customers every day. We've built enrichment and segmentation systems to identify high-value accounts across our inbound funnel.

Founder-led sales have closed enterprise deals. We've brought in experienced GTM help to build early infrastructure and playbooks. We're looking for a Technical Account Executive to join our small and growing Buyer Experience Squad.

This is a building and closing role. You'll take what exists, pressure-test it, expand it, and iterate on our repeatable sales motion. This role is remote based in the Americas Time Zones.

Read more about how we work, how we hire, and what we value here.

In this role, you will…

  • Work high-intent inbound opportunities from enriched, segmented enterprise logos and high-growth companies

  • Build on existing playbooks - we have hypotheses and early wins; you'll validate, iterate, and scale what works

  • Run experiments across messaging, timing, and channels to find repeatability

  • Expand existing customers by identifying accounts that could benefit from higher tiers or additional products

  • Prevent churn by distinguishing accounts worth saving from natural lifecycle churn

  • Be the voice of the customer internally - feeding learnings back to product, marketing, and success

  • Document everything - your learnings become the playbook the team builds on

You’ll be a great fit if you…

  • You've built before. You know what it's like to operate without a finished playbook and have built out a new role, team, or function from zero

  • You're customer-obsessed. Genuinely curious about customers' problems. Comfortable working with deeply technical infrastructure engineers and newer developers alike. You meet people where they are

  • You think like a scientist. Hypotheses, tests, measurements, iteration. You're trying to learn something with every conversation

  • You document and share. Not a lone wolf. You write things down and make the whole team smarter from your work

  • You're technical enough. You don't need to be a developer, but you can hold a credible conversation about infrastructure, APIs, and email deliverability

  • You care about craft. You notice sloppy details. You believe sales can and should be done with the same care as great product

  • You’re comfortable with travel. Conferences, prospect on-sites, team events and everything in between to help drive value to our users

What it means to join the team...

  • First 3 months focused on learning and experimentation, not rigid quotas

  • Work directly with founders who are invested in building this function the right way

  • Clear path to define quotas together based on what we learn

  • Team-oriented culture with part of quota shared

  • Honest, low-ego team with autonomy to ship

  • 100% remote with flexible schedule

  • Comp: $160,000 - $220,000 USD OTE (base + variable), commensurate with experience

Learn more about how we work:

  • How we think about buyer experience

  • What is our sales philosophy

  • What's the role of sales at Resend

jobs.title: Product Designer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Resend is growing fast, and there are now over 4 million developers using it.

We are looking for a Product Designer with a refined taste to help evolve the Resend product. We want to work with experienced individuals who can take on any problem and solve it. Resend is a developer tool that values small details and craftsmanship.

This role is fully remote based in Americas or European time zones, with some expected travel for team offsites, conferences, meetups, and more.

Read more about how we work, how we hire, and what we value here.

In this role, you will…

  • Own projects end to end: work with customer support and engineering to define the problem, explore options, validate quickly, and ship improvements that move key metrics

  • Run lightweight, self-serve research: talk to customers, test assumptions fast, and adjust direction based on what you learn

  • Prototype with AI tools to iterate ideas

  • Bring clarity to product vision and what should be built

  • Remove complexity from the users' shoulders

You will be a great fit if you...

  • Have experience as a product designer working on complex products

  • Have ownership of projects from problem definition through launch and iteration

  • Actively use of LLMs such as Claude or ChatGPT in your design workflow

  • Have a portfolio that shows strong product thinking, interaction design, and craft

  • Define success metrics and adjust based on results

  • Communicate clearly and intentionally

What it means to join the team:

  • Autonomy to "just ship it"

  • AI-native mentality with unlimited token policy

  • Attention to detail with everything that we do

  • 100% remote team with flexible working schedules

  • Honest and low-ego team

  • Ownership of problems and solutions

Resend is growing fast, with over 4 million developers now using the platform. We're looking for a Recruiter to help us source and hire bar-raising team members as we build Resend for scale.

You will proactively source candidates to continuously increase our funnel talent density, own the full-cycle recruiting process and cultivate a stand-out talent brand and community.

You will work closely with our Chief of Staff, Founders, and team to bring the best candidates into our talent network and create a positive and memorable candidate experience.

In this role, you will…

  • Orchestrate the full-cycle recruiting process from applications to screens to offers

  • Continuously improve recruiting infrastructure, including scoring rubrics, interview plans, and communication systems

  • Increase talent brand awareness through social media channels, team engagement, and community events

You will be a great fit if you...

  • Have 3-5 years of experience in technical recruiting; or technical roles with a pivot into recruiting

  • Must have worked for 2+ years in-house within a scaling startup environment

  • Ideate unique and creative sourcing strategies tailored to each role

  • Actively engage with and understand engineering culture and developer communities

  • Care deeply about candidate experience for every person who interacts with our brand

  • Are fluent in written and spoken English

You will be an exceptional fit if you also...

  • Have experience at dev tooling or software infrastructure companies

  • Are an active member of startup or engineering communities

  • Understand what it takes to scale from 50 to 100+ headcount at pace while maintaining strong values and culture
